title: Version 1.1.0-beta — Painter Overhaul, Particle VFX Studio & Workspace (.dpp)
markdown:
### Version 1.1.0-beta — Painter Overhaul, Particle VFX Studio & Workspace

#### Complete Painter Overhaul:
* **Per-Material Native Resolution Atlases:** Loaded materials now retain their authentic native resolutions (`512x512` up to `4096x4096`), grouping character submeshes under collapsible Material Groups.
* **Advanced Layer Stack & 8 Blend Modes:** Full GPU/CPU compositing support for Normal, Multiply, Screen, Overlay, Darken, Lighten, Color Dodge, and Color (HSL) with per-layer opacity.
* **New Shape & Selection Toolkits:**
  - **3D & 2D Shape Tools:** Draw Squares/Rectangles, Circles/Ellipses, and Lines with live 3D Decal projection and customizable Fill/Stroke modes.
  - **Selection Tools:** Added Rectangular Marquee, Freehand Lasso, Polygonal Lasso, and upgraded Magic Wand with Add (`Shift`) and Subtract (`Alt`) mask modes.
* **Interactive 3D & 2D Transform Gizmos:** Move, scale, resize axes independently, and rotate Decals, Text Projections, and Shapes directly in the 3D Viewport and 2D UV Canvas.
* **Fast GPU Undo/Redo & Depth-Peeling:** Instant VRAM/CPU Undo/Redo history and `Alt + Left Click` depth-peeling to select occluded submeshes.

#### Source 2 Particle VFX Simulator & Editor:
* **Deterministic 3D CPU Particle Engine:** Emulates hierarchical Source 2 `.vpcf_c` systems with child emitters, Control Point (`CP0`/`CP10`) bone sockets, trails (`C_OP_RenderTrails`), sprites (`C_OP_RenderSprites`), and 3D mesh particles (`C_OP_RenderModels`).
* **Per-Emitter VFX Customization:** Toggle emitter visibility, scale particle Size/Radius, and adjust Alpha/Opacity in real time.
* **Context-Aware Dynamic Color Pickers:** Automatically exposes dedicated pickers for Base Color (`m_ConstantColor`), Random Color Min/Max (`C_INIT_RandomColor`), and Interpolate Fade Color (`C_OP_ColorInterpolate`).
* **2D Canvas Particle Texture Painting:** Paint, erase, and layer-blend particle `.vtex` textures with live 3D feedback and direct `.vpcf_c` / `.vtex_c` VPK compilation.

#### Workspace Session, .dpp Projects & Extra Models:
* **Multi-Hero Mod Workspace (`Mod Changes`):** Switch freely between Heroes, Extra Models, and Particle VFX without losing edits. Review, load, or discard staged changes from the topbar modal.
* **Unified `.dpp` Project Files:** Save and load your entire workspace session—including all layers, blend modes, extra models, and particle overrides—into a single `.dpp` archive.
* **Extra Models Support:** Load, preview, and paint secondary hero models, summons, weapons, and ability props.

#### UI Overhaul & Official Website:
* **Illustrated Action Buttons & Card Galleries:** Redesigned sidebar and visual picker modals with artwork cards for Heroes, Community Mods, Extra Models, and Particle VFX thumbnails.
* **Live Changelog & VRF 20.1:** Synchronized with our new official web portal ([deadlock-playground.top](https://deadlock-playground.top/)) and upgraded to ValveResourceFormat 20.1 (`vpcf61` & shader v72 support).

history.title: Version 1.1.0-beta — Painter Overhaul, Particle VFX Studio & Workspace (.dpp)
highlights: VPK Library updated to latest release 20.1, allowing correct hero loading.
Per-material native resolution painting architecture with material-grouped submesh hierarchy.
New 3D & 2D Shape Tools (Square, Circle, Line), Selection Mask Suite (Rectangular, Lasso, Polygonal), and interactive 3D/2D Transform Gizmos for Decals, Text, and Shapes.
Deterministic 3D CPU Particle VFX Simulator & Editor: paint particle textures and customize emitter Size, Alpha, Constant Color, Random Color Min/Max, and Color Fade with direct .vpcf_c VPK export.
Multi-asset Mod Workspace Session and unified .dpp project files preserving layers, blend modes, Extra Models, and VFX across multiple heroes.
Full Extra Models support for editing hero summons, weapons, and ability props.
Redesigned UI with illustrated sidebar buttons, visual card gallery modals (Heroes, Mods, Extra Models, Particle thumbnails).

history.title: Version 1.0.1 — New Heroes & Topbar Menu
highlights: Added support for 6 new update heroes from models/heroes_wip/: Violet, Baba, Deadman Danny, Nurse Harrow, Ratking, and Solomon.
Highlighted the new WIP roster in the Hero Selection menu with dedicated badges.
Added update topbar menu and changelog viewing modal.

history.title: Version 1.0.0 — Initial Public Release
highlights: Native Valve pak01_dir.vpk archive reader and Source 2 binary parser (.vmdl_c, .vmat_c, .vtex_c, .vanim_c).
Real-time 3D CameraBrush texture painting and 2D UV canvas dock with non-destructive multi-layer stack.
Skeletal FK/IK posing suite with Gizmo3DSharp and procedural cloth simulation (Position-Based Dynamics).
Bespoke shaders for Infernus, Lady Geist, Viscous, Vindicta, Lash, Wraith and more heroes.
One-click direct mod export pipeline compiling custom skins into pak##_dir.vpk files directly in Citadel addons.
